README.md.overview: StudioFlow's primary architectural reference, explaining the one-person back office concept, tech stack, API catalog, and startup instructions.

sections.title: Introduction and core capabilities
sections.explanation: Presents StudioFlow's mission: helping solo designers handle AR aging, cash forecasting, and payment tracking.

sections.title: Architecture breakdown
sections.explanation: Outlines the dual architecture: React 18 / Vite frontend alongside the Express 5 API backend.

sections.title: API catalog and verification
sections.explanation: Documents the REST endpoints under /api and test verification steps.

package.json.overview: Manifest defining project dependencies for both the frontend (React, Tailwind, Lucide, GSAP) and backend (Express, CORS, dotenv, concurrently).

sections.title: Scripts and concurrent runner
sections.explanation: Configures concurrently to boot both the Express server on port 3001 and Vite client on port 5173.

sections.title: Production dependencies
sections.explanation: Lists core runtime libraries including Express 5, React 18, GSAP, and Supabase client.

src/main.jsx.overview: Application entry point mounting the root React tree into the DOM container with global CSS imports.

sections.title: DOM root mounting
sections.explanation: Imports index.css styles and initializes the ReactDOM root rendering the App component in StrictMode.

src/App.jsx.overview: Central application shell coordinating StudioFlow views, state synchronization, active modals, and quick invoice input.

sections.title: Imports and icon definitions
sections.explanation: Imports Lucide icons, UI sub-components, and API / dataService utilities.

sections.title: Application state and effect hooks
sections.explanation: Declares state for invoices, outflows, active modal dialogs, and loads initial data from dataService.

sections.title: Dashboard rendering and views
sections.explanation: Renders top metrics cards, aging tables, cash projection charts, and interactive simulators.

src/components/AgingDashboard.jsx.overview: Accounts receivable dashboard categorizing unpaid invoices into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ day overdue buckets.

sections.title: Aging calculation logic
sections.explanation: Computes elapsed days past due and groups invoices into color-coded risk tiers.

sections.title: Bucket breakdown rendering
sections.explanation: Displays visual summary cards for each aging bucket with quick action triggers.

src/components/DebtorCard.jsx.overview: Client debtor card displaying accumulated overdue debt, contact information, and WhatsApp follow-up action.

sections.title: Debtor card layout and actions
sections.explanation: Renders debtor profile, total balance, days overdue badge, and triggers WhatsApp reminder modal.

src/components/WhatsAppModal.jsx.overview: Pre-formatted WhatsApp reminder generator crafting polite payment follow-up messages.

sections.title: Template construction
sections.explanation: Generates custom message text with debtor name, amount, and due date for instant WhatsApp web dispatch.

src/components/CashForecastChart.jsx.overview: Interactive visual chart rendering projected cash balances over a 30 to 90 day future horizon.

sections.title: Chart trajectory rendering
sections.explanation: Plots daily cash curves combining scheduled receivables and outgoing operational expenses.

src/components/WhatIfSimulator.jsx.overview: Interactive scenario simulator allowing the designer to test what happens if key clients pay 15-45 days late.

sections.title: Scenario slider controls
sections.explanation: Adjusts payment delay parameters dynamically recalculating cash forecast curves in real-time.

src/lib/forecastEngine.js.overview: Pure calculation engine projecting future cash balances across calendar days from receivables and recurring outflows.

sections.title: Forecast algorithm
sections.explanation: Aggregates opening balance, planned invoice due dates, and recurring expense outflows per day.

src/components/BadDayTriageModal.jsx.overview: Crisis triage tool providing a prioritized checklist of essential outflows and rapid collection actions when cash is dangerously low.

sections.title: Triage prioritization logic
sections.explanation: Separates must-pay survival expenses from deferrable outflows and highlights fast payment targets.

src/components/OutflowsManager.jsx.overview: Studio expense manager allowing tracking and management of fixed subscriptions and variable studio bills.

sections.title: Outflow CRUD operations
sections.explanation: Renders existing studio expenses and handles adding or modifying recurring cost items.

src/components/InvoiceModal.jsx.overview: Invoice editor modal for creating and updating client invoice details, line items, and payment due dates.

sections.title: Invoice form inputs and validation
sections.explanation: Collects client name, amount, status, and due dates, saving records through dataService.

src/components/QuickInputBar.jsx.overview: Conversational input field enabling the user to type natural language sentences to draft invoices instantly.

sections.title: NLP input handling
sections.explanation: Captures user sentence input and routes it through nlpParser or the backend AI route.

src/lib/nlpParser.js.overview: Client-side regex and keyword extraction engine parsing freeform sentences into structured invoice parameters.

sections.title: Regex extraction patterns
sections.explanation: Extracts dollar amounts, client company names, and relative date expressions (e.g., 'in 2 weeks').

src/lib/dataService.js.overview: Unified data access layer providing offline-first persistence with seamless fallback from API to Supabase to localStorage.

sections.title: Multi-tier data provider resolution
sections.explanation: Attempts Express API fetch, then Supabase PostgreSQL client, falling back cleanly to localStorage.

src/lib/api.js.overview: Fetch wrapper communicating with the Express backend REST endpoints under /api.

sections.title: REST endpoint methods
sections.explanation: Exposes structured async functions for invoices, outflows, forecasts, and server health checks.

src/lib/supabaseClient.js.overview: Supabase client initialization reading environment variables or gracefully idling in guest demo mode.

sections.title: Client configuration
sections.explanation: Reads VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to instantiate the Supabase client.

src/components/AuthModal.jsx.overview: Authentication modal allowing user signup, login, and session management with Supabase Auth.

sections.title: Auth flow UI
sections.explanation: Handles credentials submission and triggers Supabase auth methods.

server/index.js.overview: Express 5 application entry point configuring middleware, registering API routers, and starting the listener.

sections.title: Express app configuration
sections.explanation: Initializes Express, enables CORS, parses JSON bodies, and registers routers under /api.

server/store.js.overview: Server-side JSON persistence manager reading and atomically updating server/data/db.json with automatic re-seeding.

sections.title: JSON database access
sections.explanation: Provides readDb and writeDb helpers with automatic initialization from seed data if missing.

server/routes/invoices.js.overview: Express router managing CRUD endpoints for client invoices and payment status transitions.

sections.title: Invoice route handlers
sections.explanation: Handles GET /api/invoices, POST creation, PATCH updates, and DELETE actions.

server/routes/forecast.js.overview: Express router serving cash forecast calculations over requested horizon periods.

sections.title: Forecast endpoint handler
sections.explanation: Reads invoices and outflows from the store and delegates projection math to the forecast engine.

server/engine/forecast.js.overview: Backend cash forecasting algorithm projecting daily cash balance curves across configurable horizons.

sections.title: Cash calculation logic
sections.explanation: Iterates daily increments applying expected inflows and outflow deductions to calculate net cash.

server/engine/nlp.js.overview: Backend natural language processing engine parsing conversational invoice prompts into invoice records.

sections.title: Sentence tokenization and parsing
sections.explanation: Matches patterns for client names, dollar values, and due date offsets.

server/test-api.js.overview: Backend integration test script running 8 verification checks against the live Express server.

sections.title: API test suite execution
sections.explanation: Executes HTTP assertions testing health, invoices, portal payment, forecast, triage, and outflows.

test_forecastEngine.js.overview: Unit test suite verifying client forecastEngine calculations, horizon bounds, and zero-balance handling.

sections.title: Forecast engine assertions
sections.explanation: Validates math accuracy, leap-year calculations, and outflow deductions.

test_e2e_phase3.js.overview: End-to-end verification script testing Phase 3 features including triage workflows, NLP drafting, and outflows.

sections.title: E2E scenario verification
sections.explanation: Runs simulated user workflows verifying integration between frontend services and backend routes.
